newsitem.title: CANADA: Norcen in offshore Louisiana oil deal.
newsitem.headline: Norcen in offshore Louisiana oil deal.

text.p: Canada's Norcen Energy Resources Ltd said on Wednesday it entered into an agreement to buy an average 20 percent interest in the South Marsh Island 269 field offshore Louisiana.
Norcen said the working interest was being acquired from Flores & Rucks Inc for US$37.2 million.
The purchase would increase Norcen's ownership in the field to an average of 39 percent.
The 269 field includes South Marsh Island blocks 268, 269 and 281 and contains five producing platforms.
Norcen is operator of the field, which has yielded over 500 billion cubic feet of natural gas and 44 million barrels of oil to date.
The company said that the net production being acquired would average 9.5 million cubic feet of gas and 1,050 barrels of oil per day.
